title: Place Value and Large Numbers
description: Reading and writing large numbers, exact and approximate values
learningObjectives: Read and write large numbers up to 8 digits
Understand place value for large numbers
Estimate outcomes of number operations
Differentiate between exact and approximate values

title: Patterns in Products
description: Patterns in products and products of large numbers
learningObjectives: Identify patterns in multiplication products
Recognise patterns when multiplying by 10, 100, 1000
Estimate products of large numbers
Connect patterns to real-world contexts

title: Simple Arithmetic Expressions
description: Reading and evaluating simple arithmetic expressions
learningObjectives: Evaluate arithmetic expressions with whole numbers
Understand the use of brackets in expressions
Identify terms in an expression
Apply the correct order of operations

title: Complex Arithmetic Expressions
description: Reading and evaluating complex arithmetic expressions
learningObjectives: Evaluate expressions with multiple operations and brackets
Apply the correct order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS)
Swap and re-group terms in expressions
Translate word problems into arithmetic expressions

title: Decimal Place Value and Operations
description: Decimal notation, writing and reading decimal numbers, operations on decimals
learningObjectives: Understand decimal place value (tenths, hundredths, thousandths)
Write and read decimal numbers correctly
Locate and compare decimal numbers
Add and subtract decimal numbers

title: Decimal Problems in Measurement
description: Real-world problems involving decimals and measurement
learningObjectives: Solve problems involving length, mass, and temperature with decimals
Convert between units using decimal notation
Apply decimal operations in measurement contexts
Solve multi-step word problems with decimals

title: Intersecting Lines and Angles
description: Properties of intersecting and parallel lines, transversals
learningObjectives: Identify intersecting and parallel lines
Understand angle relationships formed by a transversal
Recognise corresponding, alternate, and interior angles
Solve problems involving angle measures with parallel lines

title: Parallel Lines Constructions
description: Constructing parallel and perpendicular lines, real-life applications
learningObjectives: Construct parallel lines using ruler and set-square
Construct perpendicular lines
Apply parallel line properties to real-world problems
Recognise parallel lines in architecture and design

title: Fibonacci Numbers and Patterns
description: Nature's favourite sequence and number grid explorations
learningObjectives: Identify the Fibonacci sequence: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...
Recognise Fibonacci patterns in nature
Explore number grids and their properties
Understand the connection between number patterns and geometry

title: Magic Squares
description: 3×3 and 4×4 magic square patterns and properties
learningObjectives: Understand what makes a magic square
Complete 3×3 and 4×4 magic squares
Calculate the magic constant for different squares
Explore the mathematical properties of magic squares

title: Triangle Properties
description: Angle sum property, triangle inequality, types of triangles
learningObjectives: Understand the angle sum property of triangles (180°)
Apply the triangle inequality theorem
Identify different types of triangles (by sides and angles)
Construct triangles given various conditions

title: Triangle Constructions
description: Constructing triangles given sides, angles, or other conditions
learningObjectives: Construct a triangle given three sides (SSS)
Construct a triangle given two sides and the included angle (SAS)
Construct a triangle given two angles and the included side (ASA)
Apply triangle construction techniques to solve problems

title: Fraction Multiplication
description: Multiplication of fractions and connection to rectangle area
learningObjectives: Multiply fractions properly
Understand the connection between fraction multiplication and rectangle area
Simplify products to lowest form
Apply fraction multiplication in real-world contexts

title: Fraction Division
description: Division of fractions and some problems involving fractions
learningObjectives: Divide fractions properly
Understand 'invert and multiply' rule for fraction division
Simplify fraction division results
Solve real-world problems involving fraction division
